page.layout: One page of running text, one column, with Hebrew words inline. No marginal notes. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Un-". Running head "Jo. Morinus" at the top, page number 544 at the top left.

main_text.p: tiam corrigere, quod etiam fecerunt Ma-sorethæ, cùm quædâ à tractatu Sophrim adnotata omiserunt, quia sc. libros-dili-genter consulendo, ipsius observationem notare deprehenderunt. Præterea nihil ille tractatus de scribenda in margine vera lectione, & alia in textu vel è con-tra. Nihil in eo de distinctione scriptio-nis marginalis & textualis, quæ apud Ma-sorethas adeo celebris est, & totius eorum laboris effectus.
Deniqve quamo-brem nusquam citat Masorethas אנשי המסר[?] vel בעלי המסר[?] ut toties, qvi eos secuti sunt.
Præcessit igitur Masorethas autor sive autores istius tractatus, sic nec unquam Talmud Masorethas citat, istud autores Masorae vel Masorethae, est omnibus illis cognitum.

Nam hoc axioma ישאם למקראישאם למסרה[?] nihil ad rem prorsus facit, qvum Masora ibi significet traditionem, non homines aliqvos, & in illo apud Talmudicos frequenti axiomate, nihil aliud significat, qvam textum legis, Mosê Israëlis traditum, ut Talmudis glossatores interpretantur.

page.notes: The Hebrew phrases (אנשי המסר, בעלי המסר, and the axiom line) are small and partly overlapping in print; the readings are doubtful. The axiom line is marked [?] throughout. The printed "Ma-sorethas" after "apud" lacks a space in the print ("apudMa-sorethas"). The "Un-" at the foot is the catchword, not a note. Spelling of qu/qv is normalised to u/v as in the rules. The printed "Mosê" appears as "Mose" with a diacritic; kept as "Mosê".
